name: ibis budget Singapore Selegie
short_description: A 95-room budget hotel on Selegie Road, a 2-minute walk from Little India MRT, with a rooftop pool and airplane/cruise-themed rooms.
ai_summary: ibis budget Singapore Selegie sits on Selegie Road at the doorstep of Little India, about a 2-minute walk from Little India MRT Station and roughly 15 minutes on foot from both Orchard Road and Bugis Street. The 95-room economy property is known for uniquely themed rooms -- including a cabin/airplane-style twin room and cruise-ship decor -- alongside a rooftop swimming pool with city skyline views, a rarity at this price tier. Guests consistently praise the location, cleanliness, and friendly service, while reviews and aggregator scores flag rooms as very small with limited storage, typical of the ibis budget economy format. The hotel does not participate in the ALL - Accor Live Limitless loyalty programme's points or elite-tier benefits, though ALL members can still book member rates.

research_watchouts: Comfort/room-size scores are markedly lower than other rating categories across both Accor's own aggregator data and guest reviews -- rooms are very compact with little storage

faqs.question: How far is ibis budget Singapore Selegie from Little India MRT station?
faqs.answer: The hotel is about a 2-minute walk from Little India MRT Station, right at the doorstep of the Little India neighbourhood. From there, it's roughly a 15-minute walk to Orchard Road in one direction and to Bugis Street/Bugis Junction in the other.

faqs.question: Does ibis budget Singapore Selegie have a swimming pool?
faqs.answer: Yes -- it has a rooftop swimming pool with city skyline views, which is unusual for a budget-tier hotel. It does not have a gym; guests rely on the pool and the surrounding Little India area for activity and dining options.

faqs.question: Can ALL - Accor Live Limitless members earn points at ibis budget Singapore Selegie?
faqs.answer: No -- per the hotel's official ALL listing, this property does not participate in ALL points earning, redemption, or elite-tier benefits like room upgrades or lounge access. ALL members can still book member-exclusive rates when reserving directly through the ALL - Accor Live Limitless website or app.
